title: Hearty Herbal Ethiopian Sesame Seed Skewers
description: A flavorful and visually stunning Ethiopian dish featuring sesame seeds, perfect for special occasions, this recipe combines floral and herbal notes with a sweet and tangy glassy jelly, all on a gluten-free friendly skewer.

ingredients.name: sesame seeds
ingredients.notes: black or white seeds work well

instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mix together sesame seeds, lemongrass, rose petals, garlic, and ginger.
Thread the mixture onto the soaked wooden skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Place the skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and brush with olive oil.
Bake the skewers in the preheated oven for 15 minutes, or until lightly toasted.
While the skewers are baking, heat the jelly in a small saucepan over low heat until melted and smooth.
Remove the skewers from the oven and let cool for a few minutes.
Dip each skewer into the melted jelly, coating completely, then place on a wire rack to set.
Once the jelly is set, serve the skewers immediately, garnished with additional rose petals if desired.
